periods.name: 空手夺白刃
periods.status: trained throughout volume; succeeds in climax
periods.summary: A risky blade-catching counter technique. Aria demonstrates it against Shirayuki and later trains Kinji with mock attacks because Maken's sword is said to cut steel. Kinji repeatedly fails in training but in Hysteria Mode uses a one-handed variant to stop Jeanne's Durandal, enabling the final arrest.

evidence.quote: Aria sets barehanded blade catch as Kinji's first counter technique.
Training is justified because Maken's sword may cut steel.
